title: Get ANGRY!
html:
Let's get ANGRY!

I just had a chat with a young guy this morning, who is definitely a guy on the up and up, and part of our conversation was about a sales guy who worked for him.

He is a top athlete and quite an angry kind of guy. He had a team of five sales people working for him and raged for a month. Bit of an emotional rollercoaster for everyone involved but he inspired them to let nothing stand in their way and got results. In fact, he has moved on to other things and the sales are pouring still in.

Aristotle said, "Anybody can become angry - that is easy, but to be angry with the right person and to the right degree and at the right time and for the right purpose, and in the right way - that is not within everybody's power and is not easy."

Get angry, focus that anger, practise focusing that anger daily, and don't let anything stand in your way. Rage for a month and you could be surprised at how quickly results start to happen.

Have a great week,

Glenn Edley
